_why: One place for the author block. It used to be a string literal inside build_submission_docs.py, which made the affiliation a thing the builder remembered. AGENTS.md section 2 forbids answering the affiliation from memory, so check_author_identity.py resolves this file against Crossref and refuses a builder that carries its own copy.
_private_fields: The corresponding author's telephone and institutional street address are NOT in this file. This repository is public and is the version archive the manuscript cites, so anything written here is published and stays in the history. Those two fields live in paper/author_contact.local.json, which .gitignore excludes and submission/jxst/author_block.py merges in; check_author_identity.py fails if either value reaches a tracked file or any commit, and fails if the local file is missing when a title page is being built for submission.
